title: MoEQuant EBSS balance-strength fidelity experiment
frozen_at: 2026-11-10, before any normalisation-variant test, counterfactual ranking or generation

generator.change: balance_sigma(counts, n, balance_std_mode, usage_mode, top_k) + the two options threaded through generate(); nothing else

default_regression.synthetic: EQ4_RATE (options omitted AND passed explicitly) vs the frozen pre-study generator on synthetic backends: tokens, cum_logp, token_logp, sigma, final scores, picks, every step's score matrix and pruning decision -- bitwise
default_regression.historical: balance_sigma default on the stored 16 x 512 pilot counts = stored sigma bitwise (EBSS and PO); final scores bitwise
default_regression.real_model: in the 4 x 128 EQ4_RATE and PO short runs the beam state at |S| = 32, put through the length-32 final selection, must equal the score-audit 4 x 32 production outputs (same starts, same batch layout) token-for-token
default_regression.gate: any regression failure -> BALANCE-NORMALIZATION-RUN-BLOCKED, no further generation

short_generation.order: one process, one backend load, conditions in the listed order
short_generation.historical_po_reuse: NOT reused: the historical PO set was decoded with 16 sentences per batch (64 rows) and selected at length 512, so its first 128 tokens are not the output of a 4 x 128 run under the same execution protocol; PO is regenerated at 4 x 128
short_generation.pool_capture: opt-in audit hook; at every step every parent's top-(w+1) tokens by (logP desc, token id asc) with parent cum logP, logP and full [24, 60] routing counts; this reduced pool provably contains the global top-(w+1) for ANY per-parent sigma, so it is exact for counterfactual ranking

counterfactual.primary_pools: EQ4_RATE short-run trajectory (all sentence-steps with >1 parent)
counterfactual.also: pools of every other short / B=16 trajectory, reported separately
counterfactual.method: independent oracle (normalization_oracle.py): sigma of each variant from the parent counts, Eq. 13 scores, global top-w; PO = no sigma term
counterfactual.D_v: steps whose kept (parent, token) SET differs from EQ4_RATE's / tested steps; D_v_PO same vs Probability-Only; identical sets with different scores are not changes
counterfactual.strength: per step: balance spread = max - min over parents of sigma_v/tau; probability spread = max - min over parents of the parent's best-child probability component
counterfactual.caveat: local counterfactual on fixed pools, not a trajectory prediction

diagnostics.primary_routing: CANONICAL-B1 replay (forward_b1_sel of the pilot, model PPL from the same pass)
diagnostics.canonical_balance: all cross-variant balance outcomes use the EQ4_RATE definition (set_exposure: paper sigma, CV, Gini, min, p10, zero, per-layer CV); each variant's internal sigma is reported separately and never compared raw across variants
diagnostics.text: ED.text_diagnostics + distinct-3 + longest repeated n-gram + near-duplicates + zlib compression ratio (pilot text_block)
diagnostics.representativeness: routing L1 vs the frozen C4 reference (layers 1/8/16/23) and fraction routing-atypical (pilot d*); 128-token sequences are noisier than the 512-token reference, so C4 truncated to 128 tokens is reported as context

scientific_gate.reference: EQ4_RATE, same run protocol; thresholds frozen here
scientific_gate.G1_beam: counterfactual D_v (vs EQ4_RATE, primary pools) >= 0.05 AND >= 5 changed sentence-steps
scientific_gate.G2_balance: |relative difference of canonical set mean CV (24 layers, B1)| >= 0.10 vs EQ4_RATE, same sign under generation-time routing
scientific_gate.G3_lower_tail: |relative difference of mean p10 exposure| >= 0.10 OR |relative difference of mean min exposure| >= 0.20 vs EQ4_RATE (B1), same sign under generation-time routing
scientific_gate.G4_repetition: |delta distinct-2| >= 0.05 OR |delta repetition rate| >= 0.05 OR |relative delta mean longest repeated n-gram| >= 0.25 vs EQ4_RATE
scientific_gate.G5_routing: |relative difference routing L1 (mean of 1/8/16/23)| >= 0.10 OR |delta fraction atypical| >= 0.25 vs EQ4_RATE
scientific_gate.qualifies: a variant qualifies for B=16 if it passes G1 or any of G2-G5
scientific_gate.context: the PO - EQ4_RATE difference of every statistic is reported next to each variant (4 sequences x 128 tokens: one draw, no error bars)
scientific_gate.selection: ALG1_SHARE and ALG1_RATE run at B=16 if they qualify (at most two new variants); EQ4_SHARE only if fewer than two ALG1 variants qualify and it qualifies; if none qualifies no longer generation is run

full_generation.compatibility: new variants use the identical generate() call of the pilot (16 sentences in one batch, record_steps 1/2/64/256/511) + pool capture hook (read-only)

quantization.pipeline: unchanged OV.quant_config: GPTQ 4-bit, group 128, percdamp 1.0, act-order, layers [1,8,16,23], 240 experts, CANONICAL-B1 extraction, E3 held-out reconstruction, WikiText-2 partial PPL
quantization.cache: new CANONICAL-B1 capture in ~/moe_cache_ebss_balance_fidelity of the new sets + C4R_s0's 16 rows; compatibility = those C4 rows bitwise equal to the pilot cache at layers 1/8/16/23, else reference configurations are re-quantized
quantization.historical_reuse: C4R_s0/1/2, PO, EBSS(EQ4_RATE) results from runs_ebss_generation_pilot/results (read-only)

primary.RUN_BLOCKED: a regression/correctness/resource failure prevents a valid comparison
primary.MATERIAL: at least one alternative variant passes G1 on the counterfactual pools, or passes any of G2-G5 in the short generation (or at B=16 with the same thresholds)
primary.IMMATERIAL: no alternative variant passes any gate criterion

secondary_quality.GAIN: some new variant: reconstruction >= 0.5 % below EQ4_RATE AND below every C4 Random seed AND >= 0.5 % below the C4 seed mean
secondary_quality.MIXED: no GAIN, but some new variant is >= 0.5 % below EQ4_RATE (or below the C4 seed mean) on reconstruction
secondary_quality.NO_GAIN: no new variant is >= 0.5 % below EQ4_RATE and none is below the C4 seed mean
secondary_quality.ppl: reported, not used for the label

constraints: no tau/w tuning, no sampling/penalty changes, no B=128, no GPTQ change, no AGQ/rotation, no numerical-sensitivity study, no overwrite of earlier artifacts
